start_here: Say to your AI: "Send each new notice to my phone and browser." The AI turns on workflow:send-each-new-notice-to-my-devices's wake every-five-minutes with your store (the vault name of the database your notices are kept in) and audience (who the notices are for) as the switch's input.
no_lists_because: The notices, devices and sends are rows of the person's own database; this workflow reads and keeps them there and names no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Register each phone or browser that should get notices (its devices row: web-push with its push subscription, or apns with its token). That is the device's own step.
2. Switch on the wake every-five-minutes once, with store {credential_name} and audience.
3. Every five minutes each new unread notice of the last day goes once to each device registered before it, addressed to it or to every device; notice_sends keeps each send's stage.

worked_examples.title: A new notice reaches the phone
worked_examples.ask: (the five-minute due time arrived; notice told:1 is new and the phone is registered)
worked_examples.given: notices holds told:1, made after the phone registered and not read; notice_sends holds nothing for it.
worked_examples.hands_back: One send of told:1 to the phone through tool:send-notification-to-my-devices and one notice_sends row (told:1, the phone, its stage). The next run sends nothing more for it.
